description: Burn an item of a MomoSwap NFT drop for COOK from the drop itself: after graduation, the permanent floor (the locked share of the raise ÷ items outstanding — a redemption never moves it); for a drop whose window closed short, the wind-down refund (the raise ÷ items outstanding; the first refund also closes the drop on chain). Picks whichever applies; get_nft_drop shows both amounts. Burning is final — compare with list_nft first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

collection.description: the drop's collection mint (looked up from the item when omitted)
